html:
Mana Drain is a special damage type that is inflicted by the abilities of some creatures. Players are unable to deal this damage type. It is displayed in the Game console as Blue Text, the same as if the player was using an Energy Ring or Magic Shield.

Mana Drain affects the characters mana points directly, without affecting hitpoints at all. While it is impossible to die due to Mana Drain, running out of mana can be dangerous, as the player would be left unable to heal using spells.

Mana Drain is represented in the Damage Input Analyser and Cyclopedia with the following icon:

Mana Drain Protection
